scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Best District Panchayat In Providing Services And Facilities To Senior Citizens
other_conditions: Must be a District Panchayat that has done outstanding work for senior citizens
Must have exemplary contributions in health, counselling, legal aid, awareness and programmes for the elderly
Must have a significant role in the empowerment of elder people at the village level
Must have outstanding achievement in involving and participating local community in promotion of care for the elderly
Must promote a barrier‑free environment in public buildings within the panchayat area
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized recommending agency or individual
Open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹10,00,000 along with a citation, memento and travel/lodging expenses covered by the Central Government
